title: A fully faithful infinity-functor is equivalent to its full essential image
statement: Use the universe and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the coherent functors, full subcategories, mapping spaces and functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $J:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a coherent functor of infinity-categories which is fully faithful, meaning that $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal X}(x,x')\to\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal Y}(Jx,Jx')$ is an equivalence for every $x,x'\in\mathcal X$. Let $\mathcal Y_0$ be the full subcategory of $\mathcal Y$ whose objects are precisely those $y$ for which there exist $x\in\mathcal X$ and an equivalence $y\simeq Jx$ in $\mathcal Y$. The restricted functor $J_0:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y_0$ admits a coherent quasi-inverse $K:\mathcal Y_0\to\mathcal X$, with coherent natural equivalences $KJ_0\simeq1_{\mathcal X}$ and $J_0K\simeq1_{\mathcal Y_0}$.

source.place: Kerodon, Theorem 4.8.4.1 (Kerodon Tag 01JX), applied to the functor with codomain its full replete essential image. This is a Kerodon identifier, not Stacks Tag 01JX.
